baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance places the speaker under the Merciful's protection while recruiting the addressee's own protective piety as a second barrier; مِنكَ fixes the threatened direction and إِن كُنتَ makes restraint immediately testable.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance externalizes the boundary and makes it actionable between speaker and addressee.
Refuge supplies protective attachment to a shelter beyond the addressee's control.
Mercy identifies the governing quality of the invoked shelter.
Self-placement in protection makes the addressee's piety an internal brake against causing harm.

changed_reading.before: A frightened speaker asks the Merciful to protect her from the addressee.
changed_reading.after: She erects two linked barriers: divine refuge around herself and the addressee's own protective conscience against himself.

baseline_models.mechanism: The condition is not only a report about an unknown trait. Within direct address it negotiates conduct by requiring the addressee to demonstrate the state he may claim: if protective piety exists, it must appear now as restraint.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation through speech supplies the interpersonal force of the conditional.
Actual presence or occurrence makes piety a state to be verified in the present encounter.
Piety as putting oneself in protection converts identity into self-restraint.

changed_reading.before: If you happen to be pious, my appeal should matter to you.
changed_reading.after: Prove that you are pious by becoming a barrier against your own possible harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal had created distance and a screen had prevented access; an embodied human-form presence then appears on her side of that arrangement. The focus utterance functions as a portable replacement boundary when spatial privacy no longer suffices.

activation_trace.role: Protective attachment supplies the new refuge enacted after the spatial boundary fails.
Turning aside to a separate quarter supplies the first layer of chosen distance.
Prevention of access makes the screen a functional boundary rather than scenery.
Standing or presenting before someone supplies the sudden interpersonal presence.
Visible human embodiment makes the perceived threat immediate and bodily legible.

structural_cues: 19:16 moves her away from her people, and 19:17 inserts a screen before the human-form appearance.
The focus follows immediately, with مِنكَ marking the newly present figure as the direction from which refuge is sought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, access-preventing screen, and human-form presence; I infer that the presence is experienced as a privacy breach that speech must repair. The screen may separate her only from her people, so 'breach' describes her experience rather than alleging trespass.

changed_reading.before: She seeks generic protection from an alarming stranger.
changed_reading.after: She rebuilds chosen distance in speech: refuge becomes a mobile boundary after withdrawal and screening cease to secure privacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invocation of the Merciful is answered not by immediate disappearance but by a verbal identification, a gift without exchange, purity, and the later naming of the outcome as mercy. Refuge first forces intelligible disclosure, then permits the event to be reclassified without making the initial boundary mistaken.

activation_trace.role: Mercy names the protection under which the speaker places herself.
Messenger and message supply accountable identity in response to her challenge.
A gift without counterpayment reverses the apparent direction from predation to bestowal.
Purity and rectitude oppose the impurity or harm feared in the encounter.
The repeated mercy root explicitly names the disclosed outcome in the same register as her invocation.

structural_cues: 19:19 answers her boundary with speech identifying office, source, and purpose before the narrative proceeds.
19:21 repeats ر ح م and calls the outcome a mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identification, gift, purity, and repeated mercy; I infer that protection operates by compelling disclosure and changing the encounter's classification. A live alternative is that the later mercy names only the child or public sign, not the encounter itself.

changed_reading.before: Invoking the Merciful asks that the threatening presence be removed.
changed_reading.after: Invoking the Merciful secures a truthful disclosure through which an apparent threat can be distinguished from a merciful commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later language joins sexual touch and transgression to communal astonishment, blame, and family comparison. That sequence widens the harm against which the focus seeks protection: bodily integrity in the encounter and the social story that could be attached to her body afterward.

activation_trace.role: Protective piety supplies the demanded restraint at the point where harm could begin.
Sexual contact specifies the bodily domain made salient by the human-form arrival.
Sexual transgression supplies the moral category she explicitly denies of herself.
A shocking or extraordinary matter supplies the community's first public framing of what she brings.
Faulting and blame extend the threatened field from an act to family reputation.
The repeated sexual-transgression image shows the accusation being applied through maternal comparison.

structural_cues: 19:20 places negated human touch beside negated sexual transgression.
19:27-28 move from the private event to communal accusation and comparison with both parents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit no-touch and no-transgression claims followed by public reproach; I infer retrospectively that the focus alarm protects both body and social standing. The immediate utterance may have registered bodily danger alone, with reputational danger becoming visible only later.

changed_reading.before: Her refuge concerns immediate personal safety.
changed_reading.after: Her refuge marks the first defense of a bodily and reputational boundary that the following sequence will pressure from both sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus قَالَتْ begins a sequence in which protection is managed by allocating speech: she later utters a vow not to speak, uses a gesture, and another voice speaks. Repeated الرحمن makes controlled silence a continuation of refuge rather than a loss of agency.

activation_trace.role: Her first audible saying establishes direct verbal control of the encounter.
A prescribed utterance supplies the explicit transition from speaking to declared non-speaking.
The repeated Merciful keeps the later communicative discipline inside the focus invocation's protective frame.
Restraint of the tongue converts silence into a deliberate act rather than voiceless defeat.
Intelligible exchange names precisely the channel she temporarily closes.
Bodily indication preserves communicative agency while honoring verbal restraint.
A new speaker's utterance receives the burden of public verbal response.

structural_cues: 19:26 itself juxtaposes an instruction to say with a declaration that she will not speak.
The sequence then moves from her speech to tongue-restraint to gesture to the infant's speech in 19:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the speech-silence-gesture-new-speech sequence; I infer a protective protocol that reallocates testimony while preserving her agency. The silence may be ritual rather than tactical, but its placement still changes who bears public speech.

changed_reading.before: قَالَتْ is a narrative speech tag introducing a plea.
changed_reading.after: Her saying inaugurates a disciplined economy of voice in which speaking, withholding speech, and delegating response each protect a boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pairs human saying with conditional being to test an existing moral state; 19:35 pairs divine saying with imperative and resultant being after decisive determination. The echo sharpens her utterance as ethical elicitation rather than reality-making: it asks a will to manifest restraint.

activation_trace.role: Negotiated speech supplies the human attempt to alter conduct through address.
Present being supplies the morally conditioned state whose reality is tested.
Protective self-restraint defines the conduct the human condition seeks to elicit.
Decisive determination supplies the authority preceding the later performative saying.
Divine utterance supplies the contrasting speech whose result is immediate occurrence.
The grouped past, imperative, and resultant forms supply the line's explicit movement through being and coming-to-be.

structural_cues: 19:18 orders قَالَتْ before conditional كُنتَ; 19:35 orders يَقُولُ before كُن and يَكُونُ after قَضَى أَمْرًا.
Both lines pair q-w-l and k-w-n while assigning different agents and grammatical force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root pairing and changed grammar; I infer a contrast between speech that tests moral being and speech that causes being. A live alternative is a broad thematic echo around the birth rather than a deliberate contrast in speech acts.

changed_reading.before: إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا is merely a conditional description of the addressee.
changed_reading.after: Against the later كُن فَيَكُونُ, her condition is heard as finite human power used precisely: speech cannot create piety, but it can summon piety into conduct.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates collateral maternal images in a refuge verb and a divine name. It remains packet-valid because both images attach to focus roots and the context supplies internal pregnancy, labor, and birth. Render only as a lexical resonance of enclosure and close guarding, never as the lexical translation of أَعُوذُ or الرَّحْمَٰن.

activation_trace.role: The post-partum female remaining close to her young supplies a maternal guarding resonance inside the refuge root.
The womb as offspring's containing house overlays mercy with protected enclosure without replacing it.
Internal pregnancy makes the two focus-side maternal branch images contextually live.
Labor supplies the bodily transition from protected enclosure to emergence.
The explicit occurrence of birth completes the contextual sequence that activates the resonance.

changed_reading.before: The refuge formula invokes compassionate divine protection.
changed_reading.after: It also carries a carefully contained maternal-enclosure resonance: refuge clings, contains, and guards across the narrative's movement into birth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping. It remains anchored by that explicit mapped target and by the immediately preceding human-form presentation. Render it only as an affective or acoustic undertone in her speech, never by translating قَالَتْ as 'she trembled' or replacing its q-w-l sense.

activation_trace.role: The split target's tremor from fear or anger supplies a bodily vibration beneath the ordinary act of saying.
The sudden standing presentation supplies the confrontation that makes a fear-tremor overlay live.
Visible human embodiment gives the alarm an immediate perceptual object.

changed_reading.before: قَالَتْ neutrally marks the start of her reply.
changed_reading.after: The ordinary saying can be heard with a contained tremor under it: the boundary is articulated through bodily alarm, not detached narration.

strongest_changes: Withdrawal and an access-preventing screen make the focus refuge a spoken reconstruction of privacy.
Identification, gift, purity, and repeated mercy revise protection from simple removal into disclosure and reclassification.
The speech-to-silence-to-gesture-to-new-speech sequence turns communication itself into protective architecture.
Later sexual and communal language widens the threatened boundary from immediate bodily safety to social reputation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus builds a double barrier from divine refuge and the addressee's self-restraint. Context then repeats both mercy and speech in changed roles, while the packet's maternal refuge/womb branches and non-dominant q-l-l target preserve two unusual but explicitly contained resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: إِن كُنتَ may be a rhetorical conscience-test, literal uncertainty about the addressee, or both.
The reputational dimension may be active in the focus moment or may emerge only through retrospective context.
The maternal-enclosure and speech-tremor readings are branch-level overlays, not replacements for ordinary lexical meaning.
The q-w-l and k-w-n echo in 19:35 may be a specific contrast in speech acts or a broader thematic recurrence.
